summary.zh: 本次更新修复了工作台条目点击无法跳转的问题，并限制了工作台的高度。
summary.en: Workbench entries now open correctly when tapped, and the board no longer grows unbounded.

items.zh: 工作台条目点击无反应的问题已修复，现在可正确跳转到对应的 Issue 或 PR 详情
items.en: Tapping a workbench entry now opens the corresponding issue or PR instead of doing nothing

items.zh: 工作台条目现在显示所属仓库，搜索结果缺仓库信息的问题已修复
items.en: Workbench entries now show their repository, fixing missing repo context on search results

items.zh: 工作台列表高度封顶，超出部分在卡片内滚动，不再撑长个人页
items.en: The workbench list is height-capped and scrolls internally, so it no longer stretches the profile page

items.zh: 修复工作台查询里无效的排序写法，列表顺序不稳定的问题已修复
items.en: Removed an invalid inline sort from workbench queries, fixing unstable ordering
